# agent-skill-contracts

Purpose: deterministic policy-as-code checks for repository-specific SKILL.md behavior.

Use this project when a skill must retain required approval language, prohibited instructions, required files or references, declared tools, and portable paths across edits.

Primary command:
  skill-contract check <contract-file-or-directory> [--format text|json|github]

Contract filenames:
  skill-contract.yaml
  skill-contract.yml
  skill-contract.json

Exit codes:
  0 all contracts passed
  1 behavioral violation
  2 invalid command, path, syntax, or configuration

Authoritative references:
  README.md
  docs/contract-reference.md
  schema/skill-contract.schema.json

Important limits:
  The tool does not run an agent, interpret natural-language meaning, or enforce runtime permissions. It complements Agent Skill format validators and security controls.
